contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete and worn Roman copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine dating to AD 330-335 (Reece Period 17). GLORIA EXERC-ITVS reverse type depicting two soldiers holding spear and shield; two standards between them. Unclear mint mark. Obverse description: Diademed, draped and cuirassed bust, right.
